comment: Добрый дом — meme energy + utility inlines. Logo: cover always + 2-3 inlines only, TOP-RIGHT pad. Slim Cover-QA: brand lock only.
utility_test: Inline must teach OR show lived-in comfort+ OR meme-on-topic OR infographic utility. Pure decorative icon row = FAIL.
style_lock: Magazine poster cover + meme energy; high-key #FFFFFF inlines. ONE official logo TOP-RIGHT on cover + 2-3 inlines (factory paste). Meme panels on 2–4 of 7 OK.
forbidden_inline: two or more logos on one frame
decorative icon row without lived-in scene

lived_in_room.utility: Realistic sofa, kitchen nook, clean bedding — lived-in, not catalog luxury

guest_checkin_scene.label_ru: гость у двери / с телефоном / код доступа
guest_checkin_scene.utility: Scene matches H2 about check-in, keys, messenger — people-by-topic OK

comfort_plus_interior.utility: Towels, clean kitchen, Wi-Fi sticker, shoe rack — ordinary guest comfort

labeled_checklist.utility: Named guest questions — not generic «7 советов» decorative

comparison_table.utility: Two columns that differ — deposit, check-in, support

process_flow.utility: Numbered steps: book → instruction → door — one failure point

meme_panel.utility: Before/after, caption panel, comic beat — ON TOPIC посуточно pains; catalog from meme-top100.json

reaction_card.utility: Recognizable reaction face sticker or small panel — guest pain moment, not random meme
